why_this_packet_was_scrutinised_hardest.precedent: Batch127 tested 10.1.5.1 logical operators and shipped VACUOUS truth tables: .AND. was asserted only on rows where .EQV. behaves identically, so substituting the wrong operator into the source left the tests PASSING under both compilers.
why_this_packet_was_scrutinised_hardest.why_the_campaign_missed_it: That defect survived a 114-mutation oracle/input/omission campaign, because when the operator under test is wrong the oracle is wrong with it, consistently. Only mutating the operator itself exposes it.
why_this_packet_was_scrutinised_hardest.this_packet: 10.1.5.4.1 is the INTERPRETATION of logical operations - the same trap - so confirming non-recurrence was the reviewer's primary task.

truth_tables_asserted.reviewer_verification: Tables match Table 10.6. All four binary row sets are present DIRECTLY in the committed source.f90 files, not merely described in the report.

discrimination.requirement: For each operator, the asserted row set must be inconsistent with every one of the other three.
discrimination.critical_separating_rows: .AND. and .EQV. differ ONLY at FF; .OR. and .NEQV. differ ONLY at TT. Those are precisely the rows batch127 omitted.
discrimination.reviewer_reran: ALL TWELVE substitutions on BOTH toolchains: 24/24 compiled then failed at runtime, 0 unexpected passes. The three prior batch127 survivors - AND->EQV at FF, EQV->AND at FF, OR->NEQV at TT - all failed on both compilers.
discrimination.permanence: The substitutions are permanent generator data via BINARY_TRUTH_TABLES, DISCRIMINATION_ROWS and add_operator_mutations - not a one-off manual check. This is what prevents the defect class returning.

binding_density_audited.concern: 21 facets from only 6 cases is 3.5 facets per case, far denser than recent packets (batch131: 15/15; batch133: 12/12). Dense binding is not wrong in itself, but it is how a weak facet hides behind a strong one.
binding_density_audited.reviewer_verdict: NO over-bound facets found. Each facet is separately observable in the case it is bound to.
spot_checks: logical-result-type: direct .eqv. and .not. expressions passed to logical dummy arguments, with NO variable laundering
all four binary operators: every TT/TF/FT/FF facet directly asserted with distinct failure tokens and nonzero check sentinels

oracle_discipline_verified.expression_not_variable: Result-type checks observe the EXPRESSION directly. This was checked specifically because batch125 shipped KIND(observed) - KIND(.FALSE.) == 0 where observed was declared default-kind - measuring the DECLARATION rather than the expression - and that facet had to be withdrawn.
oracle_discipline_verified.no_kind_claim: No result-kind claim appears anywhere, and no KIND, mixed-kind or processor-dependent kind assertion is made. This respects the 10.1.9.3 p4 precedent that for different-kind logical operands only one of the operand kinds is required, so a specific result kind is often not assertable.
oracle_discipline_verified.sentinels: No observed sentinel is 0, blank or .FALSE. - a zero-filled logical reads false, so such an assertion could pass on a processor ignoring the feature.
oracle_discipline_verified.disclaimers_checked_both_ways: The author disclaims short-circuiting, evaluation order, arrays, nondefault kinds, defined operators and nonlogical-operand diagnostics. The reviewer confirmed none of those is in fact claimed anywhere, AND that the disclaimers are not too broad - an over-broad unobservability claim is itself a defect.

non_vacuity_by_mutation.campaign: 6 parents pass per compiler; 105/105 mutations fail = 33 wrong-oracle, 21 input, 12 OPERATOR, 6 reverse-sentinel (checks 17->18), 33 omissions.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.principle: Non-vacuity must be proved by MUTATION targeting the FEATURE UNDER TEST. For an operator packet that means operator substitution; an oracle/input/omission sweep is provably insufficient.

infrastructure_verified.test_module: discovered by the unittest gate, 6 tests
infrastructure_verified.suite_count: 1032 -> 1038, confirming the cases are genuinely executed rather than inert - the defect that blocked batch132
infrastructure_verified.no_global_totals_asserted: Checked explicitly: the module does not pin authored_facets, the case count, or declared_facets, which drift when sibling fixture or source packets integrate.
infrastructure_verified.no_review_state_asserted: Checked explicitly: the module does not assert the catalogue review state, which flips from stale to reviewed at integration.

explicit_limitations: Twenty-one facets of 10.1.5.4.1 only; operand-type-delegation remains pending and belongs to 10.1.5.1.
Establishes NOTHING about short-circuiting or evaluation order - a processor need not evaluate all of an expression if the value can be determined otherwise.
No array, nondefault-kind, defined-operator or nonlogical-operand diagnostic claim.
No result-KIND claim; only result type and value.
Passing under two compilers is corroboration, not proof of universal conformance.
